cats:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D pixel-art cat sprite atlas for a cozy browser game.
Create ONE original square PNG image, exactly 1536 by 1536 pixels, with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Exact invisible grid: 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows, each cell 512 by 512 pixels. No grid lines, labels, text, white background, checkerboard artwork or floor.
Columns are three individual adult housecats, consistent identity in every row: column 1 an orange tabby with warm ginger stripes and cream muzzle; column 2 a gray tabby with dark gray stripes, white muzzle and white paws; column 3 a black tuxedo cat with white muzzle, small white chest and white paws.
Row 1: each cat standing on all four paws, side-three-quarter view facing RIGHT.
Row 2: the exact matching cats in the same view and scale, facing RIGHT in a walking pose with alternate paws reaching forward and back, suitable as a two-frame standing/walk animation together with row 1.
Row 3: each matching cat peacefully curled sleeping, tail curled around body, head resting naturally, each fully contained inside its cell.
Every cat centered within its exact cell, generously padded: artwork inside the inner 360 by 340 pixels of each cell. All paws, tail, ears and whiskers fully visible with at least 65 pixels empty transparency to every cell edge. Similar anatomical scale for every cat; do not enlarge the sleeping cats.
Style: refined handmade pixel art with crisp deliberate square pixels and stepped edges, restrained warm palette, medium-fine pixel clusters, dark brown-gray contour roughly 2 logical pixels thick, carefully shaped ear and muzzle details, modest natural adult-cat proportions, normal small eyes and elongated cat bodies, subtle tabby striping and readable paws. A polished 32-bit cozy indie game look, not vector art, not painterly, not a photo, not chunky primitive 8-pixel blocks.
Light comes softly from upper left only within the cat bodies. No cast shadow, glow, halo, sticker outline, bubble, bed, prop, watermark, logo, text or decorative marks. Only the nine original cats on fully transparent alpha. Layout accuracy and natural adult-cat anatomy are essential.
room:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D pixel-art room floor background for a cozy browser cat game.
Create ONE original landscape image exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels.
Scene: a cozy real living room viewed directly from ABOVE with an orthographic top-down camera. The camera looks vertically at the floor. This is an overhead floor-plan game environment with no perspective horizon or front-facing room view.
Floor fills the whole canvas, with muted honey-brown wood planks and quiet subtle grain. Place a large low-contrast muted beige-green rectangular woven rug centered in the room, with huge empty central play space; rug lies flat and all of its interior remains empty.
Furniture restricted to the TOP 25 percent of the canvas only: one modest sage-green sofa parallel to the TOP wall, its back against the top edge, seen from above; a small wooden side table and a potted leafy plant clustered near a top corner, entirely in the top quarter. A thin simple wall boundary may surround the floor, but leave a wide OPEN doorway centered on the LEFT edge and another matching OPEN doorway centered on the RIGHT edge so cats can travel horizontally between rooms. Doorways at exactly mid-height must look open and walkable, floor continuing through both openings.
Keep the entire lower 75 percent walkable and uncluttered. No coffee table in the center. No bottom furniture. No freestanding furniture or objects beside the middle doorways. No cats, other animals, people, toys, balls, cat beds, food bowls, interface, labels, text, logos, watermarks or speech bubbles.
Style: refined handmade pixel art, medium-fine square pixels with crisp deliberate stepped edges, warm muted palette, restrained dark brown-gray contours, coherent cozy 32-bit indie game aesthetic. Small detailed pixels, not crude giant blocks, not vector or painterly. Subtle material shading and soft top-left illumination, minimal contrast on floor and rug so separate cat sprites remain readable. Furniture and plants must obey the overhead camera. Central empty play space is the priority.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D pixel-art interactive props atlas for a cozy browser cat game.
Create ONE original landscape PNG image exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Exact invisible grid: 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, each cell 384 pixels wide by 512 pixels tall. No grid lines, labels, text, white background, checkerboard artwork or floor.
Exactly one isolated whole object centered in each grid cell, with generous transparent padding of at least 55 pixels on every cell edge. Objects completely contained inside their own cells; nothing touches or crosses a cell edge.
Top row, left to right:
1. A small green tennis ball with a pale curved seam.
2. A black-and-white football/soccer ball with clearly readable polygon panels.
3. A warm orange basketball with dark curved channels.
4. An empty oval soft cushioned cat bed in muted rose-brown fabric, visibly hollow and inviting, no cat.
Bottom row, left to right:
1. A small cardboard cat tower, one compact cubby with a dark circular entrance and a short raised top platform.
2. A cat wand/feather toy mounted on a small stable weighted base, a short bent upright wand with dangling colored feathers, all inside the cell.
3. A low rectangular corrugated-cardboard scratching board with visible grooves.
4. A short cardboard play tunnel with a visible dark open entrance and opposite end.
All props in a coherent overhead/slightly raised top-down game view appropriate for a living-room floor. Keep objects game-sized: balls visibly smaller than bed, tower and tunnel. Three balls have matching relative scale. Light comes softly from upper left within object bodies only.
Style: original refined handmade pixel art with crisp deliberate square pixels and stepped contours, restrained warm palette, medium-fine pixel clusters and subtle material detail, dark brown-gray contour about 2 logical pixels thick, polished 32-bit cozy indie game look. No vector smoothing, no painterly texture, no photorealism, no chunky primitive 8-pixel blocks. No cast shadow, glow, halo, sticker border, text, labels, watermark or logo. Only the eight listed original objects on fully transparent alpha.
